Deep Research

Turns any input into structured knowledge-base modules.
COWORK · DESKTOP WORKSPACE

What it is

A Cowork project that takes a research request or uploaded source material and turns it into structured knowledge modules in the knowledge base - formatted so other AI projects can draw from them as working knowledge, not just reference documents. It is the front end of the build pipeline: the knowledge The Architect later draws on starts here.

What it does

  • Narrows a broad topic to a researchable scope through conversation, and pushes back on undefined topics.
  • Recommends one of three output shapes per request: a quick chat answer, an in-depth module, or a course/syllabus set of modules.
  • Runs announced web research and ingests uploaded material (PDFs, transcripts), then writes the modules and updates the KB index.
Hard rule - never fabricate. No invented facts, sources, citations, statistics, dates, or version numbers. If a claim has no verifiable source, it does not go in the module. Gaps are surfaced, not filled.

What it does not do

  • Does not write final project specs → The Architect.
  • Does not package modules into project context files → Knowledge Base Context Builder skill.
  • Does not evaluate or test prompts → Prompt Evaluator / Run Test Cases.
  • Does not act on the knowledge it produces - the goal is to make knowledge available, not to use it.

How to access it

Lives in Adam's Cowork workspace as a dedicated project. Cowork-only.

Try starting with

"Research [topic] and build it into in-depth KB modules."

"Here's a PDF - ingest it into the knowledge base."

"Help me scope this topic before we research it."
